dataList.content:
... She was happy to see me, too.
……那个人也一样，她一看到我就很高兴。
But I can't bring her home. I don't even know where her home is... or what home is. 我没办法把她带回家。我既不知道家在哪里，也不知道什么是家。

Even still... she was grateful and happy to see me.
但就算是这样……她还是一见到我就说自己很高兴。

What is "home"?
“家”是什么东西啊？

Some place that always welcomes its master's return...? Hmm... I had not thought this to be a difficult concept to explain...
随时都能回去的地方……？嗯……好难说明……

... The place where you take your first steps. Because home is where we all began our journeys.
……家是人们踏出第一步的地方。因为我们所有人的旅程都是从家里开始的。

... Then, is "outside" your home?
……那你们的家，就是叫做“外面”的空间吗？

No. But "outside" is where our homes are.
不是那样的。但是……我们的家确实在外面。

What about her...? Is her home in the Grand Magasin...?
那样的话，她呢……？她家在百货店吗……？

No. She was also... someone who used to live "outside."
不是那样的。她本来……也是活在外面的人。

... What about... the one-legged lady? Or the lady who used to sing me a song...?
……我们刚才见过的……只有一条腿的人……还有为我唱歌的人呢……？

They are all... from the "outside."
他们……全都是从外面来的人。

What about... me?
那……我呢？

Am I the... only one who was born here? Why...?
只有我……是出生在这里的吗？为什么……？

... You were woven into being by the Rouges, who lost the Voice they were supposed to hear. They made you to be their new Voice.
……因为百货店里的红派失去了他们本该听见的声音之后，对于新声音的渴求，使他们将你纺织了出来。

Am I... supposed to be a "Voice"...?
那我……以后需要成为“声音”吗？

Young Pwie, there is no such thing as what thou art "supposed to be"—thy path ought to be something thou pavest, not to be defined by others.
那是应该由吱咿决定的事情。怎能让他人……决定汝想成为什么呢。

... So... there wasn't anything you were supposed to be when you were born?
……难道你们不是为了成为什么……才诞生的吗？

... There are, indeed, certain designations that were bestowed upon us at our birth.
有些事确实是从出生的那一刻就已经定好的……

Yet, I would rather not have them define my purpose in life. I endeavor not to make it so.
但吾并不想让那些事成为人生的目的。吾正试着努力做到这一点。

I was... "supposed to be" the jade of Daguanyuan. That was the sole purpose for which I was born. And, for a while... I was.
我……生来就是为了成为大观园之玉。而且我曾经……也为了那个目的而活过。
But not anymore. Because a jade was what the elders wanted me to be, not who I wanted to become. 但现在……不再是那样了。那终究是长辈们的愿望，而不是我自己的愿望。

... Then... can I not be something that I'm supposed to become? Even if that's the whole reason I was birthed for?
……也就是说，即使生来就要成为什么东西，也可以选择不那么做吗？

Don Quixote pursed her lips with a grim expression. Pwie's question must've given her much to think about.
吱咿的话语好像令堂吉诃德感到颇为困扰，她表情严肃，一言不发。

Sensing the odd current of the room, and reminded of our earlier discussion, Pwie briefly raised their hand... and lowered it, instead choosing to ask Meursault.
这种气氛或许是让吱咿想起了先前的对话，吱咿举了下手……随即转头向默尔索问道。

Can I?
不可以吗？

That is... something only you can decide for yourself. But...
那件事……只能由你自己决定。但是……

... it is not an easy question to answer.
……这确实是个难以回答的问题。

The room had fallen completely silent now. Pwie's eyes darted around the room, not knowing where to rest...
氛围一下就变得沉闷了起来，吱咿静静地站着环顾四周。

... and they muttered:
随后它嘟囔道。

I think I understand now.
我现在好像明白了。

Hm? What did you understand?
你明白什么了？

I understand now... Why you don't want things to get awkward.
我明白人们为什么……不喜欢尴尬的气氛了。
